description: US clinician data from Doximity's public directory. By profile (slug or doximity.com/pub URL): name, credentials, specialty, practice address with coordinates, phone, fax, education and training, board certifications, awards and hospital affiliations when listed. By location (state or state/city, e.g. north-carolina/raleigh): an alphabetical page of 50 clinicians with name, credentials and slug, plus a next-page cursor. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

after.description: Location mode: cursor from a previous page (nextAfter)

location.description: Directory location: state or state/city slug, e.g. north-carolina/raleigh

profile.description: Profile slug (e.g. jane-smith-md) or https://www.doximity.com/pub/<slug> URL
